Get the template, then upload
Download the template, edit it, and upload it back.
1 Download the template Skip if you already have v3
Why start from an export? Each row carries its record key, so your edits update the existing vehicle instead of creating a duplicate. A blank sheet can only create records — never update or delete.
Embed dropdowns in the sheet
18 columns · 9 mandatory · 6 controlled lists
ColumnRequiredRule
_actionSystemBlank on export. Type DELETE to remove a record — deleting the row from the sheet does nothing.
Plate No *YesPrimary key. Unique across the file and the database.
LOT *YesLOT 3LOT 4LOT 5
Contractor *YesMust match an active contractor in Master Data (14 available).
Registration Expiry *YesDD/MM/YYYY — must be a real calendar date.
OdometerNoNumber, 0–60. Digits only, no units.
…and 12 more columns, all following one of these five rule types.
Controlled values are locked. Dropdown columns match the master lists exactly. An import can update or delete records, but never creates a new LOT, contractor, depot or category — unknown values are rejected.
